text: The quantum econophysics models of Baaquie and Ilinski breach the analogy they rely on: without the imaginary unit their formulations cannot produce interference patterns, which are a defining feature of quantum phenomena, so it is doubtful they capture genuinely quantum properties.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
abstract: For example, in the approaches developed by Baaquie and Ilinski, the absence of the imaginary unit in their formulations implies a lack of interference patterns, which are a key feature of quantum phenomena.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to the Baaquie and Ilinski quantum finance formulations
